timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: Wait, identity is the perimeter now? What happened to firewalls?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Firewalls protect a network boundary. There is no boundary anymore, Peter.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: Because everyone works from home or a Starbucks somewhere?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Exactly. So we verify WHO you are, not WHERE you are.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: How do you do that? Just a better password?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: No. Passwordless auth, FIDO2 keys, Windows Hello, MFA. The works.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: What's FIDO2? Sounds like a Star Wars droid.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: It's a hardware security key. Phish-proof. Even if you click a fake login, the key won't work on it.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: And SSO? I see that acronym everywhere.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Single Sign-On. One login gives you access to all your apps securely, no password fatigue.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: What about companies still running on-prem Active Directory?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Entra Connect syncs your on-prem AD to the cloud. Hybrid identity, best of both worlds.
